title: Dividing Fractions
subtitle: How Many Groups?
bounds: Prompt wholes 2-10; prompt fractions proper, numerator 1-9, denominator 2-10, so every cross product (a×d, b×c, whole×denominator) is a times-table fact <= 90. Answers in simplest form: whole answers <= 100; a fraction part's denominator <= 12; a mixed number's whole part <= 10. Story numbers follow the same rules. No two choices equal in value.

tiers.name: Whole ÷ Unit Fraction
tiers.description: How many 1/3s fit in 4? Each whole holds 3 of them.

tiers.name: Fraction ÷ Whole
tiers.description: Split a fraction into equal parts: the answer gets smaller.

tiers.name: Any Two Fractions
tiers.description: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor.

tiers.name: Story Problems
tiers.description: How many groups, how much per share, or a missing side.

DIVIDED_WHOLE.student: Count the pieces: each whole holds as many as the denominator. Multiply.
DIVIDED_WHOLE.teacher: Divides the whole by the unit fraction's denominator (4 ÷ 1/3 -> 4/3), i.e. multiplies by the divisor.

FLIPPED_ANSWER.student: Upside down: that is the second number ÷ the first. Keep the order.
FLIPPED_ANSWER.teacher: Gives the reciprocal of the quotient (computes divisor ÷ dividend).

MULT_WHOLE.student: Dividing by a whole number makes it smaller: split it into that many parts.
MULT_WHOLE.teacher: Multiplies the fraction by the whole-number divisor (1/2 ÷ 4 -> 2).

ADDED_TO_DENOM.student: To split into n parts, multiply the denominator by n. Don't add n.
ADDED_TO_DENOM.teacher: Adds the whole-number divisor to the denominator (1/2 ÷ 4 -> 1/6).

FLIP_FIRST.student: Flip the second fraction, not the first: keep, change, flip.
FLIP_FIRST.teacher: Inverts the dividend instead of the divisor, giving the reciprocal of the quotient.

NO_FLIP.student: You multiplied as is. To divide, multiply by the flipped divisor.
NO_FLIP.teacher: Multiplies straight across without inverting the divisor (2/3 ÷ 3/4 -> 1/2).

KEEP_DENOM.student: Same denominators: just count how many fit. No denominator in the answer.
KEEP_DENOM.teacher: Divides the numerators and keeps the common denominator (3/4 ÷ 1/4 -> 3/4).

FLIP_BOTH.student: Flip only the second fraction. The first one stays as it is.
FLIP_BOTH.teacher: Inverts both dividend and divisor before multiplying (2/3 ÷ 3/4 -> 2).

IGNORED_NUMERATOR.student: Flip the whole divisor: ÷ 3/4 means × 4/3, not just × 4.
IGNORED_NUMERATOR.teacher: Multiplies by the divisor's denominator and ignores its numerator (6 ÷ 3/4 -> 24).

WRONG_ORDER.student: Backwards: start with the amount you have, then divide it.
WRONG_ORDER.teacher: Swaps dividend and divisor in a story (3/4 lb shared by 3 -> 3 ÷ 3/4 = 4).
